question: After demonstrably successful observation-only physical training, does a cumulative causal map reach MiniGrid goals faster or with higher official discounted reward than fully trained Q, recurrent imitation, reactive and spatial-memory-sham policies, at identical training and episode/action budgets?
hypothesis: The preregistered causal-map policy will match the strongest comparator's official goal successes within one of 12 in each new held-out family, earn at least 0.04 higher mean official discounted environmental reward on BOTH unseen-size and unseen-obstacle families than the strongest control, and outperform that strongest control on at least five of twelve seed identities per family, while retaining cold goal performance after an interfering task.

predecessor_evidence.reason: MG20 fixed reactive behavior achieved 0/48 official training successes; MG21 is a separately preregistered fresh-seed trial with positive-reward public-only teacher. Do NOT reinterpret MG20 invalid result as science.

inputs.name: Pinned MG20 algorithmic substrate, reused without modifying original
inputs.source: User-owned unmerged external research-only predecessor, not authority to promote.

inputs.name: Farama MiniGrid with gymnasium and NumPy
inputs.provenance: Third-party MIT code, public partial image plus direction/reward/action only; runtime package hashes recorded by CI; no invented wheel hash.

inputs.name: Independent fresh source/split manifest
inputs.source: Verified SHA-256 of sorted-key compact JSON of explicit MG21 training/reward protocol.

seed_ranges.cold: 850001-850012, independently scored pre/post interference on each arm

frozen_design.training_behaviour: Cold-start new instance of the frozen MG20 `causal_map` public-egocentric goal navigator for EACH of the 48 training and 12 interference episodes, initialized with no hidden map or preloaded passability; actor emits only chosen actions from returned image/direction/action history and real env reward. Each demonstration is charged once physically, identical shared trace for all five arms; only this train/teacher strategy differs from invalid MG20. No evaluator, oracle goal coordinates or supervised expert annotations.
frozen_design.same_source_five_arms: causal_map, sham_map, reactive, tabular_q, recurrent_imitation. Identical architecture and hyperparameters as pinned MG20 original; trained Q and recurrent fully updated from same genuinely positive-reward physical episodes, candidate/sham observe identical public physical information; fixed heldout policy no training.
frozen_design.episodes_and_budget: 48 physical training episodes+12 shared interference episodes+four scored splits of 12 heldout seeds EACH per policy per split (240 heldout episodes) = exactly 300 real environment episodes and <=38400 env.step actions; no additional simulator work, paid inference or heldout fitting.
frozen_design.evaluator: Official emitted reward>0 defines success; official reward discounted by 0.99^physical_action_step defines aggregate return. Compare arithmetic mean per 12-seed split; report successful goal counts, per-seed return difference against strongest control, steps to goal, cold before/after reward/success, full actual selected-action SHA and environment output hashes. No pretest or in-run peeking at heldout outcomes before all freezes.
frozen_design.training_coverage: At least 24/48 shared teacher training episodes MUST earn official MiniGrid goal reward; both transfer families must contain >=3 completed goals total across 5 arms. If fewer, classify INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE and do not infer superiority.
frozen_design.cold_retention: Score original 12 cold seeds before training on DoorKey interference, then score exact same cold episodes after interference; model checkpoint serialized at each stage (persistent state), identical seed resets, evaluation never trains.
frozen_design.comparators: Strongest comparator selected ONLY by frozen per-split mean official discounted reward from sham_map, reactive, tabular_q, recurrent_imitation, not after hoc names. All controls see the same physical training observations/actions/rewards; no private agent position or mission. Explicit recurrent model update count and tabular positive reward update coverage.
frozen_design.source_and_portability: Run one once-only registered study per OS on original draft-PR-open event. Require exact selected-action and reward hashes, model checkpoint digests, success flags and non-CPU numeric values across Linux and Windows; Python 3.12, frozen public dependency versions, CPU-only. Bound persistent model checkpoint to <=64KiB per arm.
frozen_design.original_run_timing: New prereg commit precedes adapter/tests, only nonregistered toy 11/17/19 in prefirstuse. No original firstuse on synchronize, never tune using original data.

controls.name: sham_map
controls.design: MG20 equal-capacity public-memory scrambled-spatial control; no learner update changes.

controls.name: reactive
controls.design: Strong goal-aware nonlearning behavior explorer; same 128 action limit.

controls.name: tabular_q
controls.design: MG20 fully trained off-policy reward Q with actual positive official rewards and same behavior episodes, gamma .95, fixed learning rate .2.

controls.name: recurrent_imitation
controls.design: MG20 conventional 12-cell 8-step BPTT recurrent imitation, every trainable parameter group updated from positive and negative behavior actions with official episode-reward weighting, no hidden labels.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY iff actual shared teacher successes >=24/48; heldout goal event coverage >=3 per family; complete <=38400 charged actions and exactly 300 episodes; candidate goal completions >=best comparator successes -1 in both heldout families; candidate mean discounted official reward >=best single comparator in each family +0.04; candidate per-seed strictly higher official return than highest-mean control in at least 5/12 new seeds in EACH family; cold-after causal_map official goal successes >=cold-before -1 and >=reactive cold-after; all checkpoints <=64KiB; candidate total decision CPU <=3x recurrent; both OS exact original action/traces/checkpoint equality, no secret evaluator data or heldout training. A pass is external DEV only; further source-family challenge needed.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV when all training and evaluation custody, parity and task event coverage valid but primary fails and a registered positive signal exists (candidate >=2 official goals above one control in a transfer family OR candidate achieves >=9/12 heldout goals in one family and retains >=11/12 cold goals after interference).
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV when valid coverage/parity but primary false with no registered partial signal.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE if teacher <24 positive training episodes or any heldout family <3 goal completions across all arms. INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE/INVALID_REPRO if prereg source/seed/capacity/controls drift, original no longer pinned, no genuine environment calls, untrained conventional control, heldout fitting, hidden-state/mission exposure, crossOS action/reward/primary gate/checkpoint mismatch, checkpoint corrupt or wrong charge counts. A performance failure with valid custody remains MIXED/NEGATIVE.

prohibited_after_primary_run: rerunning MG20 or MG21 registered seeds after outcome
postresult reward margin or baseline changes
strengthening/tuning teacher based on MG21 heldout
accepting or deploying native Yggdrasil model from external DEV results
changing official controller or runner scope
note: Stacked provisional branch dependency on MG20 frozen SOURCE, not a merge approval. New independent seeds and reward-bearing teacher required. Preserve invalid/negative results, no GPT Library files.
